newsitem.title: USA: Alumax raises prices on Cressona products.
newsitem.headline: Alumax raises prices on Cressona products.

text.p: Alumax Extrusions Inc of Alumax Inc said Friday it had increased by $0.03 a pound prices for all extruded products of its Cressona Aluminum Co business unit.
"This fabrication increase is based on continued strong business levels and extended press lead times, and will apply to new orders," it said in a statement.
The increase is the second to be announced by the subsidiary this week.
On Thursday, Alumax Extrusions said it rose prices for its Alumax Transportation Products business unit by $0.03 a pound for all extruded products.

Based in Cressona, Pa, Alumax Extrusions makes soft alloy aluminum extrusions. It is comprised of three separate business units, namely Alumax Transportation Products, Cressona Aluminum Co, and Alumax Building & Construction Products.
Alumax Inc makes primary aluminum ingot, billet and slab, among other things.
